remarks: Set 250 feet back on a prime 2-acre cul-de-sac, this 4,634 sq ft custom Colonial defines estate-style luxury. A grand columned portico leads to a breathtaking interior featuring a signature circular iron staircase and wide-plank floors. Walls of glass in the main living areas frame lush garden views, while a romantic screened porch and sophisticated library offer elegant spaces for relaxation. The heart of the home flows seamlessly from the gourmet kitchen to a sun-drenched family room with a wet bar. Retreat to the primary sanctuary, complete with a sunrise-view balcony and a boutique-style dressing suite. Enhanced by marble baths, LED lighting, and a private-access au pair suite, this 5-bedroom residence perfectly balances timeless charm with modern flair on a sprawling, level lot built for year-round enjoyment.
